RVR Horse Rescue will be a voice for horses. We are Horse Angels on a C.L.E.A.R. Mission.  Care.Learn.Educate.Act.Rescue.
RVR takes in the worst cases and breathes life back into those who have the will to fight.
We also provide hospice care to those who can no longer fight.
The greatest reward is to rehome a rehabilitated horse. To see them happy making others happy.
